findings.text: follow-on: the run's declared negative control mutates CURRENT_PLAN onto a live plan to fail the metadata-edit case, but the new case test_a_metadata_edit_leaves_a_derived_impl_and_the_fingerprint_unchanged is not falsified by that mutation; its premise and its fingerprint assertion are each falsifiable (an authored fixture fails the premise, a prose-inclusive fingerprint fails the digest comparison), so the omission is advisory rather than a defect.

justifications.durability: the change converts a monitor into a test by freezing the plan copies; the fixtures are committed, the assertions run in the suite, and the fingerprint stability no longer moves when a live plan is edited.
justifications.evidence: both arms independently reproduced — the base tree at ba2c17c79 extracted to scratch fails test_real_plan_metadata_edits_keep_the_fingerprint_while_prose_moves_it (1 failed, 5 passed, EXIT=1), and the reviewed head dedb1bad passes (7 passed, EXIT=0); the three fixture sha256 read back byte-for-byte equal to their claimed live sources; two negative controls fire beyond the run's own (an authored fixture fails the new case's premise, and a prose-inclusive fingerprint fails its digest comparison), so one point is docked because the run's declared control exercises only the metadata-edit case.
justifications.fit: the change follows the file's existing fixture idiom, adds no plan label to a filename, symbol or comment, rewrites the module docstring to describe the frozen-copy boundary, and names the derived-impl shape as a first-class fixture rather than an inline string; one point is docked because the frozen-copy rationale is restated in both the module docstring and the inline comment above FIXTURES.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every clause of section 5's done-when holds: the metadata-edit case reads three committed copies under tests/fixtures/plan_review_store/ (legacy_plan.html with no named effort field, current_plan.html whose authored impl stands, derived_impl_plan.html whose impl derives from complete records), no case reads a live plan (grep finds no docs/plans or PLANS_DIR reference), the case passes (7 passed), and the second case asserts a plan-impl edit on the derived plan leaves the impl, its source and the fingerprint unchanged.
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed diff touches exactly the four declared paths (tests/test_plan_review_store.py and the three fixtures); no live plan, state file or index is mutated; the commit is local, conventional, carries a body, and names no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
